record_text:
Key points.
The ocean’s role. Oceans hold about 97% of Earth’s water and drive weather through evaporation and currents.

In depth.
Ocean evaporation feeds most rainfall; currents redistribute heat worldwide. The ocean is also the climate’s great buffer, absorbing heat and carbon dioxide.
source_note: Sourced: standard hydrology and water-engineering knowledge.
